pr_title: Fix `LegacySongProgress` incorrectly blocking mouse input from gameplay

issue_context.title: menu cursor showing while hovering over LegacySongProgress in Game
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

The newly added LegacySongProgress displays your menu cursor instead of the in game one when you hover over it while playing and mouse1 inputs do not get registered while menu cursor is shown, which makes it impossible to tap with mouse1 while above the LegacySongProgress

### Screenshots or videos

![osu_2022-08-02_20-21-32](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/62897397/182445984-80ffbf16-85d9-4542-8d52-17cb7c645f9b.jpg)
![osu_2022-08-02_20-21-33](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/62897397/182445986-efe79fea-0355-4606-a918-aa28b9294ce6.jpg)
![osu_2022-08-02_20-21-34](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/62897397/182445987-2b7877e6-01f3-4e57-a5df-13e87bd3e9d9.jpg)


### Version

2022.731.1-lazer

review_comments: I don't know how this works, but it seems to work.
Yeah, rather than over-thinking I just copied what is already working for `DefaultSongProgress`.

Basically `OverlayContainer` steals mouse/key/hover events from the gameplay cursor/input layer (which in turn switches the cursor from gameplay to menu, because of the [`HoveredDrawables`-based cursor visibility logic](https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/ef10145d6f9f77117e6e148cf82f76f6b89ffdb4/osu.Game/Graphics/Cursor/GlobalCursorDisplay.cs#L74-L81)), so when overriding these to `false`, the container no longer steals events and input is received normally.
